about.title: About Noor al-Seerah
about.purposeBody: Noor al-Seerah is a free, open-source timeline of the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It sets out forty-nine events in three eras, in English, Arabic and French. The order of events and the account of each follow Ar-Raheeq al-Makhtum, and the Qur'an verses and hadith narrations that relate to an event are shown beside it.
about.additionalSourcesHeading: Other works named in the events
about.methodologyBody: The events and their order follow Ar-Raheeq al-Makhtum by Safiur Rahman al-Mubarakpuri. Each hadith is shown as sunnah.com publishes it for that collection and number, with its grading: in English on the English and French pages, because sunnah.com publishes no French text, and in Arabic on the Arabic pages. When only part of a narration is shown, the page says so. Two narrations that sunnah.com does not carry have an English and French rendering made for this project, and each is labelled. Qur'an verses are the Uthmani text from the Quran.com API, with Saheeh International in English and Hamidullah in French. The summaries and the notes on why an event matters are written for this site and say which source they follow.
about.differencesBody: The sources differ on some dates and details, and the event pages say so where they do. A date marked c. is approximate, or is a range, because the sources differ. Dates are counted in years before the Hijrah (BH) and after it (AH), with the Common Era year beside them. Years before the Hijrah are counted back in lunar years from 1 Muharram, 1 AH, so a source that counts elapsed years may give a number one lower. The Common Era year is converted from the lunar year and can be one year out. Where scholars differ on a ruling or on how to read a text, this project does not choose between them. This is a reading aid and not a substitute for study with a qualified scholar.
about.sadaqahBody: This project is intended as sadaqah jariyah, an ongoing charity. We ask Allah to accept this effort and make it a source of benefit.
